title: MostlyTrue_so_Plenty
description: MostlyTrue so Plenty is an add‑on for those who play with the Biomes O' Plenty mod, to enhance the graphic quality of his news.
body:
### English:

**MostlyTrue is made for those who love enjoying the game and the adventure without giving up realism.** The purpose is to visually replace the internal textures provided by the "Biomes 'O Plenty" (BOP) mod, in order to give a realistic feeling and unify the graphical appearance of Minecraft together with MostlyTrue projects. **This texture pack does not affect the functionality of BOP or any other mod in any way; it solely provides a cosmetic change to the appearance of 'Minecraft: Java Edition' while using BOP.**

Have you found treasures and mysterious traces of ancient civilizations and other worlds? Yes!? Ok, now will be more painfull... Not yet!? Ok, now will be more... will be more... Plenty!
... and there will be more light in the distance also…

If you liked the texture pack but feel the need for a smoother gameplay experience… don’t give up too much realism and try the FeelTrue x32 project. It’s a unique pack — and it’s free!


### Español:

**MostlyTrue está hecho para quienes disfrutan del juego y la aventura sin renunciar al realismo.** El propósito es reemplazar visualmente las texturas internas proporcionadas por el mod "Biomes 'O Plenty" (BOP), con el fin de ofrecer una sensación más realista y unificar la apariencia gráfica de Minecraft junto con los proyectos MostlyTrue. **Este paquete de texturas no afecta en absoluto la funcionalidad de BOP ni de ningún otro mod; únicamente realiza un cambio cosmético en la apariencia de 'Minecraft: Java Edition' mientras se usa BOP.**

Has encontrado tesoros y huellas misteriosas de civilizaciones antiguas y otros mundos? Que sì? Sale, ahora pronto te iras a sufrir mas... Todavia no!? Bueno, ahora irà a ser mas... a ser mas... Abundante!
... y hay mas luzes allá al fondo tambièn...

Si te gustó el paquete de texturas pero sientes la necesidad de una experiencia de juego más fluida… no sacrifiques demasiado realismo y prueba el proyecto FeelTrue x32. ¡Es un paquete único y es gratis!


### Italiano:

MostlyTrue è fatto per chi ama godersi il gioco e l'avventura, senza rinunciare al realismo. L'obiettivo è di rimpiazzare visivamente le textures interne create dalla mod "Biomes 'O Plenty" (BOP), al fine di offrire sensazioni realistiche e unificare l'aspetto grafico di Minecraft insieme ai progetti MostlyTrue. **Questo pacchetto di textures non modifica in nessun modo le funzionalità di BOP nè di altre mod; si limita unicamente a cambiare l'estetica e l'apparenza di 'Minecraft: Java Edition' mentre si usa BOP.**

Hai trovato tesori e tracce misteriose di civiltà antiche e di altri mondi? Sì!? Bene, ora sarà più doloroso di prima!... Non ancora!? Ottimo, ora diventerà più... diventerà più... Esagerato!
... e ci saranno pure più luci là in fondo...

Se il pacchetto di texture ti è piaciuto ma senti la necessità di un'esperienza di gioco più fluida… non rinunciare troppo al realismo e prova il progetto FeelTrue x32. E' un pacchetto unico ed è gratis!

![[Resource packs SEQUENCE | SECUENCIA | SEQUENZA]](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/728601ab4b92b98d93e59b3506e27d40cc1934f1.png)

Below is a summary of the key information you need to get the best experience when using Minecraft with my texture packs:

_1  ESSENTIAL MODS FOR USE WITH FABRIC/IRIS SHADERS:
-     **_BiomesOPlenty_** - adds biomes and materials; WARNING! This mod permanently alters your Minecraft world!
-     **_continuity_** - adds large scale texture tiling and randomization tiling feature
-     **_entity_model_feature_fabric (EMF)_** - adds customizable entity model feature
-     **_entity_texture_feature_fabric (ETF)_** - adds customizable entity texture feature
-     **_fabric-api_** - adds customization and shader supports
-     **_fabric-language-kotlin_** - required to interpret certain codes
-     **_GlitchCore_** - required by BiomesOPlenty Mod
-     **_indium_** - required by fabric
-     **_iris-fabric_** - required by fabric
-     **_sodium-fabric_** - required by fabric
-     **_TerraBlender_** - required by BiomesOPlenty Mod

_2 For those USING THE OFFICIAL MICROSOFT LAUNCHER, the correct installation procedure is:

- Do not start the launcher.
- First download and run fabric-installer, then iris-installer; choose 1.21.11 VERSION, for example.

**_See below how to choose loader version, matching Sodium version. In this example, the most significant digit is the first one, namely the 8, which must match._**

- ![Installation instruction](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/148d2167f459a5e0933ee3c5d253f652767d1018.png)

- After that, check the path (usually C:\Users\ [username] \AppData\Roaming\ .minecraft) and make sure the folder "iris-reserved" and version subfolder "1.21.11" has been created; if they’re missing, create them manually.
- Paste all the mods listed above into the VERSION subfolder.
- Now start the launcher and make sure a new installation has been created with a name like "iris-fabric-loader-0.18.6-1.21.11". If it’s not there, something went wrong and you need to repeat the procedure.
- Before launching the game, I recommend checking how much memory is allocated. Go to the Installations menu and edit the profile you just created. At the bottom, in the JVM Arguments field, change the first string "-Xmx2G" to "-Xmx4G" if you have up to 16 GB of RAM, or to "-Xmx7G" if you have up to 32 GB.
- Now launch the game… if the mods are compatible with each other, everything will work fine; otherwise, you’ll need to check which mod has the wrong VERSION.
- REMEMBER: only the group of mods listed above is guaranteed not to conflict. If you add other mods, you may experience crashes.
